reduction_guard.reason: Reduction must preserve the task-declared consumer. A deadline witness keeps its deadline and the business-continuation family keeps its declared continuation; parameters (indices, horizons) may still shrink. Without this guard, greedy reduction turns the completion-gap witness into a smaller raw-race witness and silently changes the task the candidate answers.

revision_note: v1 over v0: added reduction_guard after the first search run (20260913-SEARCH-L1-001) showed that unguarded reduction collapses the completion-divergence family into the raw-race family. Search space and budgets are unchanged.

calibration_benchmark.note: Known external comparison only. The enumerator walks the declared grammar; this entry is used after the run to check that the known mechanism is covered.

declared_bounds_note: Complete enumeration of this declared grammar within the budget. This is NOT a claim about all HoTT propositions or models.
